# SqlFmt v0.5.0 - Table of Contents

Pretty print SQL queries

## Pages

- [README](https://sql-fmt.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [SqlFmt](https://sql-fmt.hexdocs.pm/SqlFmt.md): This library provides an Elixir wrapper around the Rust
[sqlformat](https://github.com/shssoichiro/sqlformat-rs) library. This allows you
to efficiently format and pretty print SQL queries.

- [SqlFmt.FormatOptions](https://sql-fmt.hexdocs.pm/SqlFmt.FormatOptions.md): These options are used to control how the SQL statement is formatted. The
available formatting options are
- [SqlFmt.Helpers](https://sql-fmt.hexdocs.pm/SqlFmt.Helpers.md): This module contains the `~SQL` sigil implementation.
- [SqlFmt.MixFormatter](https://sql-fmt.hexdocs.pm/SqlFmt.MixFormatter.md): Format SQL queries from `.sql` files or `~SQL` sigils.
